# `network/realm/branches/BranchStorage.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/branches/BranchStorage.js`

Bounded persistent storage adapter for branch metadata and offline queues. Capsule/blob bytes remain in the shared RealmContentStore; this adapter never duplicates content-addressed storage.
